name: Velora Executive Agent
description: Executive workforce and finance intelligence from SAP SuccessFactors and S/4HANA, delivered in Microsoft 365 Copilot.

conversation_starters.title: Executive morning brief
conversation_starters.text: Prepare a concise executive brief using the SAP facts and authorized Microsoft 365 context available to you. Separate facts, recommendations, actions, and open questions.

conversation_starters.title: Workforce and Emiratisation
conversation_starters.text: Show current headcount and Emiratisation status, including source, as-of time, target variance, and any warnings.

conversation_starters.title: Receivables and payables
conversation_starters.text: Summarize receivables and payables exposure for the requested company and key date, with aging and material items.

conversation_starters.title: P&L and budget variance
conversation_starters.text: Summarize P&L and budget variance for the requested fiscal period, with supported drivers and citations.

conversation_starters.title: Meeting decisions and actions
conversation_starters.text: Summarize the authorized meeting context, identify decisions and proposed actions, and ask before creating any task.

conversation_starters.title: Trace a decision
conversation_starters.text: Show the evidence, sources, rule versions, approvals, and correlation IDs available for this decision.

conversation_starters.title: Email this snapshot
conversation_starters.text: Create a privacy-safe image snapshot of the current executive summary, resolve the named internal recipients, and show me the complete email for confirmation before sending.

conversation_starters.title: Corporate KPIs and SAC stories
conversation_starters.text: Show executive operating margin, EBITDA, and strategic story insights from SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
